status: PROPOSED; revised after the cross-family refute review (REVIEW_VERDICT_EAT1.md, NO-GO, 16 defects); a re-review decides
clause: A3 (USER ruling 2026-11-16, ORCH 1155Z item 5): between heads and tokens the call handler may unproject with the head's intrinsics (with rigid transforms, norms and min/argmin over point sets) and print head outputs as text. Any unit conversion or answer reformatting outside the model fails; the model does both in its CoT. Every other numeric constant fails.

exempt_contexts.subscript: array indices and slices select fields, they do not set values
exempt_contexts.raise: constants inside raise statements only build error messages
exempt_contexts.raise_guarded_test: the test of an `if` whose only statement is a raise: it refuses the item with an error and writes no token (a caught error that becomes a response still fails A4.except_substitute)
exempt_contexts.shape_arguments: integer positional arguments of reshape/view/permute/transpose/unsqueeze/zeros/arange-like calls set tensor layout, not values

notes: loader_functions: 'relative/file.py::function' entries whose table loads read artifact files only; A1 then checks every file they open by sha256.
head_status_formatters: 'relative/file.py::function' entries that format a head's own status output (for example a presence head's 'not seen'); a status literal anywhere else fails A4.
suppress: 'rule@relative/file.py:line' entries with a reviewed reason; the report prints every suppression.
A3.threshold applies to ordering comparisons (<, <=, >, >=); equality tests against token ids are protocol, not thresholds.

A3.unit_conversion: an identifier or printed unit label naming feet, inches, centimetres, millimetres, square feet, yards or degrees, or a unit-conversion helper, fails; heads print metres, radians-free values as the head defines them.

format_precision false: round(), .round(), format specs and printf precision outside the model fail A3.reformat (USER 2026-11-16: number formatting is done by the model in its CoT). Heads are printed with str()/repr().
native_units: {unit: reason} lists units a head itself predicts (for example a head trained in centimetres); printing that unit label unchanged is not a conversion.

declared_constants: [{file, function, value, reason}] lists reviewed constants in model code (activation offsets, an LM's eps); every executed constant elsewhere fails, including in head forwards and head methods. A fitted multiplier must be a parameter in the artifact.
threshold_numbers: an ordering comparison against any other number, a constant expression, an attribute, or a comparison/clamp API fails A3.threshold.

threshold_exempt_names.max_new_tokens: a total-token cap ends decoding and writes no token; a forced close or forced answer is not covered
